description: This source file defines a Swift class 'DevicePairingApprovalPrompter' responsible for managing device pairing requests within a macOS application. It handles loading pending pairing requests, presenting alerts to the user, and processing their responses, including approving or rejecting device connection requests. The class interacts with external components like 'GatewayConnection' for network communication and 'PairingAlertSupport' for user interface prompts and alert management.

classes.name: DevicePairingApprovalPrompter
classes.description: A singleton class managing device pairing request workflows, including requesting, presenting alerts, user responses, and network approvals.

classes.name: PairingList
classes.description: A Codable struct representing the list of pending and paired devices.

classes.name: PairedDevice
classes.description: A Codable, Equatable struct representing a device that has been paired, including its metadata.

classes.name: PendingRequest
classes.description: A Codable, Equatable, Identifiable struct representing a device pairing request pending user action.

classes.name: PairingResolvedEvent
classes.description: Typealias for event value class from 'PairingAlertSupport' indicating a resolution of a pairing request.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the pairing prompt workflow by starting the push task.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the pairing prompt workflow, clears pending data, and resets internal state.

methods.name: startPushTask
methods.description: Begins listening for incoming pairing requests and resolution pushes.

methods.name: stopPushTask
methods.description: Stops listening for push events related to pairing requests.

methods.name: loadPendingRequestsFromGateway
methods.description: Async function to fetch the current list of pairing requests from the network gateway.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies a fetched list of pairing requests to update the internal queue and UI state.

methods.name: updatePendingCounts
methods.description: Updates counters indicating the total number of pending requests and repair requests.

methods.name: presentNextIfNeeded
methods.description: Triggers presentation of the next pairing request alert if conditions allow.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays the pairing alert prompt for a specific request.

methods.name: handleAlertResponse
methods.description: Processes user response from the pairing alert, handling approval, rejection, or deferment.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Async method to send approval for a device pairing request to the network gateway.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Async method to send rejection for a device pairing request to the network gateway.

methods.name: endActiveAlert
methods.description: Ends the current active pairing alert.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming push notifications, filtering for device pairing requests or resolutions.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a new pairing request to the queue and updates the UI state.

methods.name: handleResolved
methods.description: Handles a pairing resolution event, updating UI and internal state accordingly.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Generates a descriptive string summarizing a pairing request for display.
